title: A great tour with food, wine, and history
text: This was an excellent tour, Marcel was knowledgeable, friendly, and made the tour a delight. This worked really well for us as Australians with limited Spanish and was a great introduction to the city.
author: K5055ZRarim

title: Tapas and Wine Tour - A MUST DO!
text: Manuel is exceptional! A stand out tour amongst the rest, quite honestly. The tapas, wines and vermouth absolutely exceptional! The history, culture, terroir behind each dish, wine and vermouth, equally exceptional! A MUST DO with Manuel. Our small group from around the world matched the experience.
author: 21melanit

title: Memorable Night
text: Absolutely fantastic night.  Katia was a wealth of knowledge, picked some amazing places for us to wine and dine, and have the say the entire group was just perfect.  Thanks so much Katia for organising, the lady for trusting an Englishman to guide her around Granada, the NASA ladies for great talk and everyone else who was such a delight.  Really was a memorable night.
author: D2218GYjasonh

title: Amazing night!!
text: Absolutely fantastic experience with Katie!!  Amazing company, guide was fantastic, 100% recommend!!!!
author: JMH71

title: Our family had a fun and...
text: Our family had a fun and educational tour of several shops, restaurants and tapas bars over lunchtime. Would definitely recommend!
author: James_C

title: Loving tapas in Granada
text: Bruce was a wonderful guide.  He took us to three great restaurants and we ate some very good local dishes.  His stories are great as well.
author: Donald_J

title: Fantastic evening in granada
text: This was one of my favorite food tours we have done. Maria the guide was fantastic, knowledgeable, and a great story teller. We went to three restaurants plus a candy store. She picked out fantastic wines and dishes and I left happy and stuffed. The walk through the spice shop with her was delightful. The smells of the spices, teas, and the stories that went with them were lovely. Highly recommend!
author: RDR56003

title: Absolutely fantastic
text: Absolutely fabulous tour incredible knowledge and passion for Granada and it’s history. The food was incredible and very plentiful.  The wine was amazing and we walked away feeling incredibly happy.
author: Tracey_B

title: Secrets of Granada cuisine
text: This was one of the best food and wine tours I have done in Spain. Katia is a true specialist in this field and we were treated  to a wonderful selection of local foods and wines with some other specialty stores along the way. I recommend the evening tour. Granada at night is very beautiful and comes alive.
author: 281nadinep

title: Great experience
text:
Great fun - amazing food/wines/local guide Katia
Recommend highly!
author: schoolhousegirls
